title: Black Clover Season 2 Preview Reveals First Look at the Fight Fans Waited 5 Years For
content:
Black Clover Season 2 has been working its way through the rematches against the Spade Kingdom’s Dark Triad, and the first look preview for the next episode has dropped the first look at one of the coolest fights yet as Magna steps into action. Black Clover Season 2 has thankfully returned to action against the Dark Triad after five long years of waiting for these fights to go down , and the episodes thus far have been pushing each of the Magic Knights to their respective limits against their strongest foes yet.

Black Clover Season 2 Episode 4 ended with a tease that Magna and Zora had made their way to the Spade Kingdom as Asta was fighting the now fused devil twins, and the first look at the next episode is setting up for Magna’s big fight. It’s his biggest moment in the series from Yuki Tabata’s original manga, and it’s the most anticipated fight for the second season overall as Magna takes on Dante. Check out the preview images for Black Clover Season 2 Episode 5 below.

Black Clover Season 2 Episode 5 Reveals First Look & Synopsis

Black Clover Season 2 Episode 5 is titled “The Best vs. The Worst,” and will be making its debut in Japan on October 31st, and will be streaming exclusively with Crunchyroll when it hits for fans in North America and other international territories. The episodes thus far have been packed to the brim with all sorts of notable fights as the arc jumps in between each of the members of the Dark Triad, but there’s been a renewed focus on Dante as Nacht had been facing off against the twins. With Asta taking them out of the picture, it’s time to take on Dante in full.

That’s what’s being teased by the synopsis for the episode on the anime’s official website too, “Asta rushes to Nacht’s aid, uniting with Liebe to confront Lilith. Meanwhile, Magna and Zora of the Black Bulls arrive to help Jack, who is battling Dante, the Dark Triad, who has reached 100% of his demonic power.” Magna’s debut in this second season has been especially looked forward to as his fight with Dante in the manga is the most unique that fans will see in the series from now on . And that’s even including the final arc.

What to Know for Magna vs. Dante

Magna’s fight against Dante was one of the big moments teased with the new opening sequence for Black Clover Season 2 , and the synopsis for the episode further reveals how this comes to be with the detailing of Magna’s newly developed spell for the occasion, “Dante appears confident despite his overwhelming magical power. However, Magna unleashes a new magic spell using a magic word he spent six months developing: ‘Underworld Flame Magic: Soul Chain Deathmatch.’” And this levels the playing field between the two.

It’s still not an easy fight however as the rest of the synopsis teases, “Even so, Dante, with his physical magic, remains a formidable opponent. But Magna, with the ‘guts’ that Yami acknowledged, clings to Dante!” It’s Magna’s biggest moment of the series that he’s been building to since the very beginning, so make sure to catch the episode when it hits. What are you hoping to see from the fight between Magna and Dante in Black Clover Season 2? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: Looney Tunes Voice Actor Eric Bauza Dies at 46
content:
The family of voice actor Eric Bauza announced on his Instagram account that he had suddenly died on Sunday. The announcement stated that there will be more details to come. Entertainment news website Variety reported that according to Los Angeles County Medical Examiner records, Bauza died at his home due to hypertensive cardiovascular disease. He was 46.

Bauza was born in Scarborough, Toronto on December 7, 1979. His first voice acting role was in The Ripping Friends in 2001, and his first major role was as the new voice of Stimpy in Ren & Stimpy "Adult Party Cartoon." He is perhaps best known for voicing many classic characters in the Looney Tunes franchise . He voiced Marvin the Martian in The Looney Tunes Show in 2011. He later voiced Bugs Bunny, Daffy Duck, Tweety, and more characters in the modern Looney Tunes Cartoons and video games for the franchise . In the 2021 Space Jam: A New Legacy film, Bauza voiced Daffy Duck, Porky Pig, Foghorn Leghorn, Elmer Fudd, and Marvin the Martian. In 2023, Bauza became the new voice of Buster Bunny in the Tiny Toons Looniversity reboot show. He also voiced characters in Avatar: The Last Airbender , Alvin and the Chipmunks: The Squeakquel , Scooby-Doo! Mystery Incorporated , and more. He played Diddy Kong and Toad General in The Super Mario Bros. Movie .

This year, Bauza reprised his role as Toad General in The Super Mario Galaxy Movie . He also played Mr. Mailbox, Worry Well, Couchy, Trashy, and Pee Flower in the horror film Buddy . In the recent Coyote vs. Acme film alone, Bauza voiced Bugs Bunny, Charlie Dog, Daffy Duck, Dr. Peter Lorre, Foghorn Leghorn, Gossamer, Pepé Le Pew, Porky Pig, Road Runner, Senator Elmer Fudd, and Tweety. His latest and last feature film role was in Forgotten Island , where he voiced Gen. Button Wutton and the mythological creature Sarangay. According to Variety, Bauza was in pre-production on two projects at the time of his death: as Daffy Duck in Bye Bye Bunny: A Looney Tunes Musical and as The Shogun King in The Dragon Masters .

In anime, Bauza is the English voice of Kenjirō Takōda in The Fable and Zigita Zogi the One Thousand and First in the second season of Ishura . Bauza also voiced Amadeus Cho in Avengers Confidential: Black Widow & Punisher , Two-Face in Batman Ninja , and Technovore/Ezekiel Stane in Iron Man: Rise of Technovore .

Bauza has won three Children's & Family Emmy Awards for Teen Titans Go! , Bugs Bunny Builders, and Looney Tunes Cartoons . He also received five nominations for Daytime Emmy Awards for his work on Looney Tunes Cartoons , Muppet Babies and The Adventures of Puss in Boots .

title: Eric Bauza’s Final Performance is Another Looney Tunes Film That Warner Bros. Originally Cancelled
content:
Eric Bauza, the modern voice of Looney Tunes icons such as Bugs Bunny and more has died at the age of 46 , and one of his final performances will be in a new Looney Tunes film that had been initially cancelled by Warner Bros. Discovery. Before Warner Bros. went through yet another merger with Paramount to form Skydance, its initial merger with Discovery had resulted in a number of new animated projects announced to be in the works that were subsequently shelved a few years later.

Some of these famous projects include the recently released The Day the Earth Blew Up: A Looney Tunes Movie and Coyote vs. Acme (which went on to box office success), but there was one other that had seemingly been cancelled forever. Bye Bye Bunny: A Looney Tunes Musical was seemingly cancelled back in 2022, but a recent update from Variety has revealed that Bauza was currently in pre-production on the film as of the time of his death. Meaning that there was a move towards release for the film once more.

Bye Bye Bunny: A Looney Tunes Musical Revealed to Be in Production Following Cancellation

Bye Bye Bunny: A Looney Tunes Musical was first announced to be in the works for a release with Cartoon Network and HBO Max in 2022 , and was subsequently cancelled alongside other animated projects like Batman: Caped Crusader, The Day The Earth Blew Up: A Looney Tunes Movie, Merry Little Batman and more. Notably many of these other cancelled projects eventually were saved and released through other distributors or streaming services, so it seems like it was going to be the same case for this Looney Tunes musical as well.

But unfortunately with Bauza passing away in the midst of the film’s pre-production, it’s not quite clear how far along the musical actually is. With the passing of the lead star behind the film, it’s not clear just how much voice work he had been able to record. This ultimately might lead to the film being shelved once more depending on how the newly formed Skydance decides to move forward with the Looney Tunes property (and its potentially in development projects) with the loss of their biggest voice star .

You Should Watch Coyote vs. Acme

For now, Bauza’s final performance as Bugs Bunny (and many other Looney Tunes icons) can be heard in the recently released Coyote vs. Acme , which the actor had been a great champion of while it was in limbo. When the film was originally scrapped for tax purposes by Warner Bros. Discovery and had no hope of release, Bauza often took as many opportunities as he could to have a distributor save the film from its fate such as when he took the stafe at the Annie Awards in 2023 .

Acting out a scene between Bugs Bunny and Daffy Duck, Bauza took a shot at Warner Bros. Discovery, “It could’ve been worse, Daffy. We could be Wile E. Coyote right now.” Which Bauza (as Daffy) then responded with, “I hate to be political, but release Coyote vs. Acme !” Bauza’s campaigning along with the rest of the team eventually did lead to the successful release of the film ( which is now available to buy or rent on digital stores ), and it proved that the Looney Tunes truly could kick off a new era.

Are you hoping to see Bye Bye Bunny: A Looney Tunes Musical release someday? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

HT – Variety

title: The World's Strongest Witch Anime Casts Yukana, Azusa Tadokoro
content:
The official website for the anime of Mochimaru Sakaki 's The World's Strongest Witch: I'm Starting My Free Life in a World Where Only I Can See the Online Strategy Guide ( Sekai Saikyō no Majo, Hajimemashita : Watashi dake "Kōryaku Site" o Mireru Sekai de Jiyū ni Ikimasu ) light novel series revealed two new cast members for the anime on Monday. Both new characters will appear in the anime's fourth episode on Wednesday. The new cast members include ( Note: Character name romanizations are not confirmed. ):

When Lorna manifests a completely useless ability, she's labeled an embarrassment to her family and kicked out of the house. With no money or food, she's about to hit rock bottom. But then, she figures out how to use her supposedly worthless SSS-Rank skill, “Internet.” This cheat-level talent gives her the know-how to gather an unlimited amount of valuable items and easily acquire rare equipment. Armed with godlike knowledge, Lorna's free to do anything she wants! If only she could figure out what "lmfao" means…

The anime debuted in Japan on October 7. Crunchyroll streams the anime as it airs, and is also streaming an English dub .

The anime stars:

• Azusa Tachibana as Rona Hermit

• Fairouz Ai as Erimina

• Honoka Inoue as Eruna

• Kana Hanazawa as Aries Tear Bluemoon

• Maria Naganawa as Ruru Ru Rie

• Yūto Uemura voices Reinhardt Highwind

• Nana Mizuki as Yggdrasil

Jōji Furuta ( ēlDLIVE , Double Decker! Doug & Kirill , Bad Girl ) is directing the anime at the studios Bridge and Aisle . Shoji Yonemura ( Pokémon Journeys: The Series , One Piece 2013-onwards, Bad Girl ) is in charge of the series scripts. Yūki Morimoto ( Cardfight!! Vanguard GZ , Boarding School Juliet , Bad Girl ) is designing the characters.

HoneyWorks feat. HaKoniwalily perform the opening theme song "Eikyōryoku∞Idol" (Infinitely Influential Idol), and the group Rokudenashi perform the ending theme song "Hoshi o Muguru" (Traversing the Stars).

title: 'As a Reincarnated Aristocrat, I'll Use My Appraisal Skill' Season 3's 3rd Video Unveils New Arc, More Cast
content:
The official website for the third season of the television anime of Miraijin A 's As a Reincarnated Aristocrat, I'll Use My Appraisal Skill to Rise in the World ( Tensei Kizoku Kantei Sukiru de Nariagaru - Jakushō Ryōchi o Uketsuidanode, Yūshūna Jinzai o Fuyashite Itara, Saikyō Ryōchi ni Natteta ) light novel series unveiled on Monday the anime's third promotional video, new visual, and new cast members who will appear in the "Fujimiya Family Arc." The anime's new arc will start in its sixth episode on November 1.

The newly announced cast members are:

Toshiya Miyata as Rikuya Fujimiya

Mariya Ise as Maika Fujimiya

Takaki Ōtomari as Takao Fujimiya

Returning cast members include:

• Natsumi Fujiwara as Ars Louvent

• Taito Ban as Ritsu Muses

• Narumi Kaho as Charlotte Wraith

• Miho Okasaki as Rosell Kischa

• Kana Hanazawa as Lycia Plaid

• Hitomi Nabatame as Mireille Grandion

• Haruka Tomatsu as Fahm

Previously announced new cast members are Sumire Morohoshi as Musia Trick, and Hinata Tadokoro as Zaht Brouzdo.

Takao Kato ( To Love-Ru , Zoids ) returns to direct the third season at new studio GeyeG Pictures . Daisuke Ōhigashi , who wrote episode scripts for the previous seasons, is now overseeing the series scripts, replacing Yasuhiro Nakanishi . Yūko Yahiro ( Kaguya-sama: Love is War ) is also back to design the characters, and Kujira Yumemi ( In the Land of Leadale ) returns to compose the music.

Rico Sasaki performs the season's opening theme song "Still Water," while Akuruyo no Hitsuji performs the ending theme song "Hibi o Koete."

The third anime season premiered on CBC , TBS , and 26 other stations on September 27; on BS NTV on September 29; and on AT-X on October 1. The anime began streaming on U-NEXT , d Anime Store , and Anime Hōdai on September 28, and then on other streaming sites on October 1. Crunchyroll streams the season as it airs.

Kodansha USA Publishing has licensed Natsumi Inoue 's manga adaptation and light novel series (under its Vertical imprint). The company describes the story:

One day when leaving work, Ars Louvent dies and is reborn as a weak aristocrat in another world. Using his “Appraisal” skill, which lets him see the stats of others, he recruits the best people to his side in order to turn his country's fortunes around. Based on a hit light novel with over 30 million online views in Japan!

The first anime season premiered in April 2024 as the debut series for the new "Agaru Anime" programming block on CBC , TBS , and 26 other affiliated networks.

The second season premiered in Japan in September 2024. Crunchyroll streamed the anime as it aired in Japan.

The light novel series debuted in October 2019 on the Shōsetsuka ni Narō (Let's Become Novelists) website. Kodansha publishes the light novel series with illustrations by jimmy. The manga adaptation launched in Kodansha 's Magazine Pocket in June 2020.

title: The Eternal Fool's Words of Wisdom Anime Casts Minori Fujidera
content:
The staff for the television anime of Hifumi's The Eternal Fool's Words of Wisdom ( Yūkyū no Gusha Asley no, Kenja no Susume ) novels revealed the anime's main visual and an additional cast member on Monday.

The novels' illustrator Kurihito Mutō and manga adaptation artist Fuh Araki also drew commemorative illustrations to celebrate the anime adaptation:

Minori Fujidera joins the anime's cast as Rina, a young, hardworking girl living in the ruined village Falltown. She fights with a sword, but also possesses a hidden talent for magic.

Toshiyuki Toyonaga will star in the anime as Asley, and Yōko Hikasa will voice Pochi.

Keisuke Ōnishi ( The Healer Who Was Banished From His Party, Is, in Fact, the Strongest ) is directing the series at Studio Elle . Kurasumi Sunayama ( Dr. Stone: Science Future , Harem in the Labyrinth of Another World ) is in charge of the series scripts, and Yumiko Mizuno ( The Healer Who Was Banished From His Party, Is, in Fact, the Strongest ) will design the characters. Yuri Habuka ( Maebashi Witches , Sushi and Beyond ) is composing the music at Lantis .

Other staff members include:

• Art design, Art Director: Kaya Aoki

• Color Key Artist: Yūsuke Watanabe

• Compositing Director of Photography: Yūsaku Murakami

• Sound Director: Yukio Nagasaki

• Sound Effects: Hiromune Kurahashi

• Sound Production: Procen Studio

• Animation Producer: Suguru Shakagōri

The anime will debut in January 2027.

J-Novel Club is releasing the novels' manga adaptation under the title The Eternal Fool's Words of Wisdom: A Pawsitively Fantastic Adventure , and it describes the story:

A couple thousand years of solitude would wear down any young man—that is, anyone except Asley, an eternally youthful and eternally foolish sorcerer. After all, he has man's best friend...er, familiar, to keep him company. When his Level 100 canine companion Pochi demands that he get some fresh air for the first time in two centuries, Asley sets out to reintegrate into society and test his magic mettle. His mission? Dropping several unglamorous titles from his repertoire and restoring his good (okay, decent) name. A brand-new world and fresh adventures await Asley after his many years of hermitage. Perhaps he'll lend Pochi a hand to place first in the mysterious Familiar Feud. Or maybe he'll lose all vestiges of dignity and turn tail. Whichever comes first! No matter what, Asley has great evil to fight, a big world to save, and even a little growing up to do...that is, if he can endure Pochi's “friendly advice” along the way!

Hifumi began serializing the original story on the Shōsetsuka ni Narō website in January 2015, and ended it in September 2019. Taibundo Publishing released the first print volume in September 2015, with illustrations by Kurihito Mutō , and released the 14th and final volume in December 2019.

Fuh Araki launched the manga adaptation on Earth Star Entertainment 's Comic Earth Star website in April 2017. Earth Star Entertainment shipped the 13th compiled book volume for the manga on February 12. J-Novel Club released the manga's 10th volume in English on September 9. The manga is also available on the Crunchyroll Manga app.

title: Black Clover Season 2 Episode 5 Preview Teases Magna and Zora Action
content:
Black Clover Season 2 has released preview images and synopsis for Episode 5 (Episode 175 overall) ahead of its October 31 premiere. The new season officially began on October 3, 2026 , with Crunchyroll streaming it worldwide. The anime previously revealed a special Devil Union Asta visual following Episode 3. The official Episode 5 “The Ultimate VS The Lowest” synopsis:

Asta rushes to Nacht’s aid in his moment of crisis. Fusing with Liebe through Devil Union, he confronts Lilith. Meanwhile, Magna and Zora of the Black Bulls arrive to assist Jack, who is battling Dante of the Dark Triad, now wielding 100% of his devil power. Dante remains confident, boasting an overwhelming amount of magical power. However, Magna unleashes a new spell that he spent six months developing: Secret Flame Magic: Soul Chain Deathmatch! Even so, Dante remains a formidable opponent thanks to his Body Magic. But Magna refuses to back down, standing his ground against Dante with the very “guts” that earned him Yami’s recognition!

You can see the preview images below:

The main staff for Season 2 includes:

• Director: Ayataka Tanemura

• Series Composition: Keiichiro Ochi

• Character Design: Itsuko Takeda

• Sub-Character Design: Kumiko Tokunaga

• Prop Design: Kosei Takahashi

• Music: Minako Seki

• Animation Production: Studio Pierrot

The opening song by WANIMA is titled “Kienai Riyuu” (The Reason That Won’t Disappear).

ALSO READ: Black Clover Creator Draws Toru Oikawa From Haikyu!! Black Clover Final Volume and Official Guidebook Released, Includes New 15-Page Manga by Yuki Tabata

You can also see the main visual .

The Black Clover manga was serialized in the Weekly Shonen Jump magazine from 2015 to August 2023, before transferring to Jump GIGA . It entered its final arc in August 2022 and officially ended on May 1 after eleven years of serialization. The manga is available to read on Viz Media’s website, MANGA Plus website, and the Shonen Jump mobile app in English.

It received a 170-episode anime adaptation by Studio Pierrot, which ran from 2017 to 2021. The Black Clover: Sword of the Wizard King movie premiered on June 16 and is streaming on Netflix. Crunchyroll streams the TV anime, and they describe the story:

In a world where magic is everything, Asta and Yuno are both found abandoned at a church on the same day. While Yuno is gifted with exceptional magical powers, Asta is the only one in this world without any. At the age of fifteen, both receive grimoires, magic books that amplify their holder’s magic. Asta’s is a rare Grimoire of Anti-Magic that negates and repels his opponent’s spells. Being opposite but good rivals, Yuno and Asta are ready for the hardest of challenges to achieve their common dream: to be the Wizard King. Giving up is never an option!

title: 'Tensei Kizoku, Kantei Skill de Nariagaru 3rd Season' Unveils Additional Cast, Third Promo for Fujimiya Family Arc
content:
The official website for the television anime adaptation of Miraijin A 's Tensei Kizoku, Kantei Skill de Nariagaru: Jakushou Ryouchi wo Uketsuida node, Yuushuu na Jinzai wo Fuyashiteitara, Saikyou Ryouchi ni Natteta ( As a Reincarnated Aristocrat, I'll Use My Appraisal Skill to Rise in the World ) light novel unveiled additional cast, a third key visual (pictured), and the third promotional video for the third season on Monday. The new arc is scheduled to premiere on November 1 at 11:30 p.m. on CBC and TBS' 28-station "Agaru Anime" programming block.

Cast Rikuya Fujimiya: Toshiya Miyata ( Ore wa Seikan Kokka no Akutoku Ryoushu! ) Maika Fujimiya: Mariya Ise ( Made in Abyss ) Takao Fujimiya: Takaki Ootomari ( Hibi wa Sugiredo Meshi Umashi )

Takao Kato ( Pandora Hearts ) is directing the anime at GeyeG Pictures , with Hiroaki Matsushima ( Arifureta Shokugyou de Sekai Saikyou 2nd Season episode director) serving as assistant director. Daisuke Oohigashi ( Fate/Strange Fake ) is handling the series composition. Yuuko Yahiro ( Kaguya-sama wa Kokurasetai: Tensai-tachi no Renai Zunousen ) is designing the characters. Kujira Yumemi ( Lv2 kara Cheat datta Motoyuusha Kouho no Mattari Isekai Life ) is composing the music.

Produced by studio MOTHER , the first season aired in 12-episode in Spring 2024, followed by the second season in Fall 2024. Crunchyroll streamed the anime with subtitles in multiple languages and an English dub.

Miraijin A began penning the novel on the Shousetsuka ni Narou website in October 2019. Kodansha published the first volume with illustrations by JIMMY under its K Ranobe Books imprint in July 2020. The ninth volume went on sale on June 2, with the tenth volume scheduled for a December 2 release.

Natsumi Inoue began drawing a manga adaptation on the Magazine pocket app in June 2020. Kodansha published the 21th volume on June 9.

Kodansha USA licensed both the manga and light novel in English in November 2021 and March 2022, respectively. The 14th manga volume went on sale on April 21. The seventh light novel volume was published in November 2025.

title: Goddess of Victory: Nikke Game Gets New Manga Adaptation
content:
The official X (formerly Twitter ) account for Kadokawa 's Dengeki Maoh magazine announced on Saturday that SHIFT UP 's Goddess of Victory: Nikke game will receive a new official manga adaptation by Yokoshima Penguin this winter to celebrate the franchise's fourth anniversary. The manga will focus on the Goddess squad as the main characters.

Yokoshima Penguin has contributed to Nikke manga anthologies in the past.

The game previously inspired a slice-of-life manga by Kio Utsusumi titled Goddess of Victory: Nikke Sweet Encounter .

Goddess of Victory: Nikke combines gacha card collecting with shooter-style gameplay. Publisher Level Infinite launched the game globally on iOS and Android devices on November 4, 2022. The game also launched a PC version in February 2023 with single account login and cross-play with the mobile version. As Level Infinite describes the story, "players lead a squad of android soldiers called Nikke, the last hope for reclaiming the overworld from a vicious race of aliens called Raptures who have forced humanity underground."

The game has featured collaborations with Chainsaw Man , NieR: Automata , Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- , and Evangelion .

A-1 Pictures animated a special video for the game's "Old Tales" event in 2024.
